AtomsAI / AI Services

Put AI where the work actually happens.

We find the process worth fixing, build AI into the systems you already run, and stay until it holds up in production. Then it runs without us.

Talk to our team See our approach
One request, five steps

A request is rarely one task

A customer changes a delivery date. That means checking the order, finding a new slot, following policy, updating dispatch, and confirming the change.

We connect the steps that get the whole job done.

Two services

Pick the right problem. Then build it right

01 · AI Consulting

AI Consulting

Find the work worth automating.

We sit with your workflows, measure where time and money leak, and pick the few places AI will pay back.

02 · AI Engineering

AI Engineering

Make it work in your business.

Our engineers tune the models to your outcomes, connect your systems, and test it all against how your business actually runs.

Where it applies

Work worth handing off

  • 01

    Customer conversations

    Answer inquiries, qualify requests, book appointments, and manage follow-ups.

  • 02

    Documents & records

    Read, verify, and process invoices, applications, and claims.

  • 03

    Business operations

    Handle order changes, approvals, and exceptions across teams and systems.

  • 04

    Customer intelligence

    Listen across every conversation, spot the risks, and surface the next action.

Integration

Keep your tools. Connect the work

Your systems already hold the context. We connect it to AI, with the permissions and approvals to act on it.

Track record

Proven in production, at scale

Our applications handle over a billion conversations a year, on models and infrastructure we build ourselves through PyAI. What we engineer for you comes from that experience.

Our approach

You see it work before you run it

We build in your environment, test on your real cases, and measure quality, speed, and cost before anything goes live.

01 · Understand

Find the workflow worth improving

We sit with the people doing the work, measure where time and cost go, and agree on the one process to start with.

  • Process map
  • Baseline metrics
  • Scope
02 · Design

Map the data, decisions, and controls

Which systems hold the context, which decisions AI can make, and which need a person. The controls are designed before the first line of code.

  • Data sources
  • Decision rules
  • Approvals
03 · Build

Develop and integrate the solution

We build in your environment and connect your systems, so what we test is what you will run.

  • Your repository
  • Integrations
  • Your environment
04 · Validate

Test performance against agreed targets

Real scenarios, measured for quality, speed, and cost against the targets we set in step one. Nothing goes live on a demo.

  • Evaluation set
  • Quality
  • Speed and cost
05 · Hand over

Your code, evaluations, documentation, and operational controls

Everything needed to run, review, and improve the system is handed to your team, with the evaluations that prove it works.

  • Code
  • Evaluations
  • Runbook
Explore our approach with us
